title: Proving Alpha: How a Hedge Fund Measures AI's ROI - Hari Kumar, Contour Asset Management
talk_summary: A hedge fund's head of AI describes how they measure ROI on AI tooling by running live A/B tests of analyst workflows with and without AI, tracking cost-per-useful-insight and time spent per name. The talk is mostly about organizational measurement and process, with little technical mechanism that transfers to an agent orchestration system.

takeaways.technique: Live A/B of workflow with vs without AI
takeaways.what_they_do: They record an analyst's pre-AI process for one name over a three-month earnings cycle, then rerun the same process with AI tools layered in one at a time, comparing data sources and conclusions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: creating live AB tests by recording and documenting their entire process that they would have done in a pre-AI world

takeaways.what_they_do: They track insights generated per analyst per day, time spent per name, and a derived 'cost per useful insight' that ties spend and time to outcomes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: tracking things like a cost per useful insight, which is the metric that we've come up with

takeaways.technique: Agents that resurface stale work on timing triggers
takeaways.what_they_do: Agents continuously track notes/ideas that were dropped, monitor them against the market, and re-flag them to the analyst and PM when they become interesting again.
takeaways.evidence_quote: having agents that are also tracking through all of the notes that you've been taking, even if you only worked on an idea for a day

takeaways.technique: Unify piecemeal vendor tools behind one internal layer via MCP/API
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of analysts using separate vendor portals, they pull vendor data (AlphaSense, Yipit) through APIs/MCP into one internal platform that learns each analyst's patterns.
takeaways.evidence_quote: still use things like an AlphaSense or Yipit tool, but bring them into our own platform internally

takeaways.technique: Count maintenance/fix time in the ROI equation
takeaways.what_they_do: They explicitly subtract time lost to broken model calls and connectors from the value of AI tooling, tracking it as a cost line.
takeaways.evidence_quote: what is the time that that being taken away trying to fix bugs
